title: Weighted composition operators on the Fock space
summary: In this paper, we discuss the compactness, invertibility and isometry of the operators on the Fock space formed by multiplying a weighted composition operator with the adjoint of another weighted composition operator to form either $W_{g, ψ}W_{f, \varphi}^*$ or $W_{g, ψ}^*W_{f, \varphi}$.
